content.text:
The gate report lists one verified finding (FIG‑3's drive‑face geometry) and no other failing mechanical checks. I applied exactly the prescribed fix to `figures/FIG-3.md` and touched nothing else, so the description, claims, drawing list, and numeral table stay byte‑for‑byte as approved.

Note on prior art: no search was run for this application, and the art in `prior_art/` is all that was available — the art of record may be incomplete.

input.summary: Removed the undisclosed circumferential position and clearance topology that figures/FIG-3.md asserted for the functional ring drive face 54. The brief now states only that a short plain drive face lies on the band, shown schematically, with the clearance wording recast as a drawing-legibility instruction so the lead line reads cleanly. No claim, description, drawing-description, or numeral-table text was changed, because the detailed description says only that the wedge 52 is driven against a ring drive face 54 of the cam ring 30, shown in FIG. 3 — it carries no positional statement to synchronize. No rendered artifact was edited; the drawing pipeline re-renders FIG. 3 from the corrected brief. Prior-art note: no search was run for this application, so the art available in prior_art/ may be incomplete.
changes: figures/FIG-3.md: replaced the fourth 'Geometry to draw' bullet so it no longer states that the drive face lies near the right junction, that the right junction is the latch end of the closed frame, or that the face is clear of the three slots and of the abutting end faces as a disclosed relationship; the clearance is now expressed as a schematic drafting instruction for lead-line legibility.
figures/FIG-3.md: replaced the numeral placement target for 54 so it identifies the short plain drive face on the band without the undisclosed 'near the right junction' location.

No edits to draft/07-drawings.md, draft/08-detailed-description.md, draft/09-claims.md, or draft/numerals.md - none of them carries the removed positional matter, so the four remain synchronized with the corrected brief.

patches.find: - A short plain drive face on the band near the right junction, which is the latch end of the closed frame, the drive face being clear of the three slots and clear of the abutting end faces at that junction. The drive face is shown schematically.
patches.replace: - A short plain drive face on the band. The drive face is shown schematically, and is drawn clear of the three slot outlines and of the junction end faces so that its lead line reads cleanly.
patches.why: The disclosure states only that a wedge is driven against a drive face of the cam ring. It never states where on the ring that face lies, that its location is the latch end, or how it stands relative to the oblique slots or the segment end faces. Those were figure-brief inventions on a functional face, so they are removed; the remaining clearance wording is a drafting instruction for legible lead lines, not an asserted structural relationship.
